user.title: Connect Home Assistant to Hermes Agent
user.description:
Home Assistant connects OUT to the Hermes Agent machine/container.

URL: enter the base URL for the Hermes host/container that Home Assistant can reach, for example http://hermes.local:7860 or http://192.168.1.20:7860. This is not your Home Assistant URL.

Token: enter the token Hermes expects for its API/WebSocket receiver. Use HERMES_HA_WS_TOKEN if you set it; otherwise use the Hermes API token from API_SERVER_KEY or HERMES_API_KEY. This is not a Home Assistant long-lived access token.

Route: Home Assistant connects → Hermes host/container URL → Hermes API/WebSocket receiver.

data.url: Hermes host/container URL (not your Home Assistant URL)
data.token: Hermes API/WebSocket token (not a Home Assistant token)

data_description.url: The base URL of the machine or container running Hermes Agent, e.g. http://hermes.local:7860. Home Assistant must be able to reach this address.
data_description.token: The bearer token expected by Hermes Agent: HERMES_HA_WS_TOKEN if set, otherwise API_SERVER_KEY or HERMES_API_KEY. Do not paste a Home Assistant long-lived access token here.

error.url_invalid: URL must start with http:// or https://
error.token_required: Hermes API / WebSocket token is required

data.entity_filter: Entity IDs to monitor (empty = all; one per line or comma-separated)

data_description.local_intents: Controls only requests after they reach the Hermes agent. Off (default): Hermes performs no extra local handling. Answers: HA answers known read-only queries locally. Commands: HA also executes recognised command intents locally; these bypass Hermes safety lists and audit logging. HA sentence-trigger automations and a pipeline's 'Prefer handling commands locally' option run upstream and are not disabled here.

data.wake_word: Wake-word keyword(s) (one per line or comma-separated)
data.media_player_entity: Media player entity ID for TTS playback

panel.title: Voice panel control (optional)
panel.description: Optional. Lets Hermes show a line of text, set the screen brightness and set the speaker volume on one voice panel, using [HW:...] markers in its reply. The markers are removed before the reply is spoken. Leave the panel device empty to keep this off. Each route also needs its entity. Brightness and volume are always kept within the ranges below, whatever Hermes asks for. Requires the Hermes-side plugins from the same release.

data_description.panel_device_id: Markers are handled only for Assist requests from this device. Empty means off.
data_description.panel_hud_entity: A text or input_text entity the panel displays. Empty disables the HUD route.
data_description.panel_light_entity: The panel's screen backlight. Empty disables the brightness route.
data_description.panel_volume_entity: A number or input_number entity for the panel speaker. Percentages map onto the entity's own min-max range. Empty disables the volume route.
data_description.panel_hud_max_length: Longer HUD text is cut to this length, or to the entity's own maximum if that is lower.

error.panel_min_above_max: The minimum can't be higher than the maximum.
